annotations.title: Ambolt Link Checker: Check the Links on a Page

description: Checks every link on one public web page (up to 60 unique links) and reports which are broken, which redirect and which sit behind bot protection. Bot walls (403, 429, Cloudflare and similar challenges) are reported as "blocked", never as broken. Each problem comes with a suggested fix. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).

url.description: A public http(s) page address, for example https://example.com/blog.
